campaign.title: M1 D=1 paired-interior moving-cell trace gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Audit primary incomplete quadratic, polynomial-character, fixed-modulus root, short character, theta, and spectral theorems only against the exact boundary-frozen selected trace. Record modulus, interval and quotient variables, coefficient class, signs, prime-power hypotheses, zero and fold exclusions, all spectral pieces, endpoints, and every restored N-M-V-d power.

frozen_target.question: Can the exact moving-mask Abel trace inside the paired interior D=d=L=1 nonzero theta matrix be proved target-sized after sign-adapted prefix or suffix summation, safe zero and Nyquist trace removal, and exact selected-coordinate rewriting; if not, what is the first strict-prefix, arithmetic, sign, coefficient, endpoint, source, or restored-power obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Fix q=4N, c=q/d, H=c/2, and V<|j|<=2V. With B_j(x)=1_(x>=lambda_sigma(j))F_j(x), lambda_+(j)=j+1, lambda_-(j)=-j, define P^+_(d,v)(j)=sum_(s=a_+)^j K(-v^2,-s;c) and P^-_(d,v)(j)=sum_(s=j)^(b_-) K(-v^2,-s;c). The paired trace is -i(1+i)/(2Nq) sum_(d|N,d odd)chi_4(d)d sqrt(c) times [sum_(j in J_+)F_j(j+1)sum_(v mod H,v!=0,H/2)e_c(-2v(j+1))P^+_(d,v)(j)+sum_(j in J_-)F_j(-j)sum_(v mod H,v!=0,H/2)e_c(2vj)P^-_(d,v)(j)], with exact strict endpoints. Its full-v physical form is sum_j F_j(j+1)sum_(s<=j)G_N((j+1)^2-s)+sum_j F_j(-j)sum_(s>=j)G_N(j^2-s).
quantities: Retain arbitrary N, every odd d|N, c=4N/d, H=c/2, both complementary interior representatives, and the edge case c=4.
Retain both signed blocks, prefix orientation on the positive side, suffix orientation on the negative side, every Abel outer endpoint, and the exact sign of each moving atom.
Retain the actual complex residual phase, zero-extended profile, transitions, asymmetric cell, half-open choices, hard endpoints, and external B_(1,U)(1) seam.
Prove the full-frequency delta-mass inversion and separately bound the v=0 and v=H/2 trace pieces; do not transfer their total-row theorems to an Abel piece.
Compute complete p-adic root tables for j^2+j+1 and j^2-j, including p=2 and p=3.
Distinguish the endpoint s=j from every strict prefix s<j or suffix s>j term.
Rewrite the strict trace in selected coordinates with its literal boundary-frozen coefficient and chi_4 quotient.
Treat min(M,V) as support cardinality only; a signed square-root theorem remains a separate input.
Restore every N-M-V-d-c factor before assigning a gain.
No trace result transfers to the profile bulk, full paired matrix, D>1, L>1, generic t=1, t>=2, cross, M2, endpoint uniformity, M9, bridge, target, or exponent owners.

completion_criteria: Independently derive the exact sign-adapted coefficient differences, prefix and suffix Abel identities, moving trace, and all outer endpoint terms.
Derive the exact full-frequency physical trace and the normalized relation to the paired interior trace.
Prove separate target-safe bounds for the zero-frequency and Nyquist Abel-trace pieces or identify the first exact failure.
Prove the complete prime-power root counts for the two endpoint polynomials and the resulting endpoint subrow power.
Derive the exact strict selected trace with all profiles, phases, signs, transitions, endpoints, and quotient characters.
Prove the whole trace target, isolate a strict owner-complete range or subrow, or establish the first exact strict-prefix, arithmetic, sign, coefficient, endpoint, or restored-power obstruction.
Source-audit every imported incomplete quadratic, polynomial-character, fixed-modulus root, character-sum, theta, or spectral theorem against the literal trace.
Close under exactly one label: paired_interior_cell_trace_target, strict_paired_interior_cell_trace_range, or paired_interior_cell_trace_no_go.

review_seams.requirement: Positive prefix and negative suffix identities, moving atoms, and every outer endpoint are exact.
Delta-mass inversion is normalized, and zero and Nyquist trace pieces are separately controlled.
All prime powers are checked and endpoint roots are not confused with strict prefixes or suffixes.
The literal boundary-frozen selected weight, signs, profiles, transitions, endpoints, and all N-M-V-d-c powers are restored.
Sources match the exact trace, capacities are not signed theorems, and no profile-bulk or broader owner is promoted.
